title: UPS Battery Runtime Remaining
exclusions: Does not estimate remaining runtime for PDU-only metering, static transfer switch controller logs without UPS-MIB polling, or predictive models that lack direct upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining samples in Splunk.
evidence: Export the saved UPS Battery Runtime Remaining alert definition plus a frozen Search query over index=power sourcetype=snmp:ups for the audited week, archived with timestamps that line up with facility incident tickets.

dataSources: Collect UPS-MIB upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining (mapped to Splunk field runtime_min) and related load percentages (load_pct) through Splunk Connect for SNMP ([Splunkbase app ID 6266](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/6266)) or the SNMP Modular Input add-on ([Splunkbase app ID 1537](https://splunkbase.splunk.com/app/1537)) in line with SNMP TA (UPS-MIB upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining) guidance; land events on index=power with sourcetype="snmp:ups" plus dimensions ups_name, location, and battery_status used in this UC.

description: Monitors UC-15.1.10 — UPS, Battery, Runtime, Remaining — using `index=power` sourcetype `snmp:ups`, grouped by `entity`. Outputs `count` each `the scheduled window`; alert when `runtime_min` < 10, `runtime_min` < 20, or `load_pct` > 70. Primary focus: Runtime Remaining. Purpose-built for 'UPS Battery Runtime Remaining' in Operations workflows.
value: UC-15.1.10 helps teams contain UPS, Battery, Runtime, Remaining scenarios and reduce operational risk and delayed incident response before incidents compound.
implementation: Poll upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining every 1–5 minutes via the configured SNMP TA path, persisting runtime_min and load_pct on sourcetype=snmp:ups; alert when runtime_min crosses the site policy (for example below ten minutes) or when the high-load branch in the saved search fires; correlate every page with concurrent generator transfer or maintenance windows recorded in facility change tools.
visualization: Single-value tile for minimum runtime_min across ups_name for the site; trellis or gauge row per UPS showing runtime_min with color thresholds; line or area chart of runtime_min over time with load_pct overlaid as a second axis; optional table drilldown sorted by ascending runtime_min with location and battery_status for war-room triage.

knownFalsePositives:
1. **Maintenance window on `power` (UC-15.1.10)** — Planned work for 'UPS Battery Runtime Remaining' shifts `count` over `span=1h` while `host` remains in-scope.  Cross-check CMDB CHG.

2. **Batch `count` on `snmp:ups`** — Scheduled automation elevates `src` without crossing `runtime_min` < 10 for UC-15.1.10. Compare `_time` minute against the job schedule.

3. **Synthetic probe on `host`** — Health checks in `power` populate the same fields the SPL groups on. Exclude monitoring-tagged assets before paging.

4. **Onboarding burst for `snmp:ups`** — First 48h baseline for UC-15.1.10 on `host` is unstable; window via `ops_exception_register.csv`.

**Suppression mechanism:** `ops_exception_register.csv` keyed on `host`, `exception_reason`, `valid_until`.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Deploy SNMP TA (UPS-MIB upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining) collection using Splunk Connect for SNMP (Splunkbase app ID 6266) or SNMP Modular Input (Splunkbase app ID 1537) on a Heavy Forwarder that can reach UPS management interfaces over UDP/161 (or SC4SNMP-equivalent polling) and vault SNMPv3 credentials outside repository-tracked configs.
• Reserve index=power (or your contracted SNMP landing index) and confirm transforms or SC4SNMP processors emit sourcetype=snmp:ups with FIELDALIAS/EVAL mappings that populate runtime_min from upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining, load_pct, ups_name, location, and battery_status exactly as referenced by this UC.
• Grant operators a scoped Splunk RBAC role such as power_ops with search rights limited to index=power plus dependent lookups; separate scheduler identities should carry schedule_search without broad admin capabilities.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Author snmp modular-input or Splunk Connect for SNMP profiles that poll UPS-MIB upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining every one to five minutes (cron such as */5 * * * *), documenting OID-to-field parity in internal runbooks so firmware upgrades cannot silently rename counters.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
Paste the UC SPL into Search, constrain earliest=-15m@m during tuning, then save as an alert with dispatch windows aligned to the polling cadence; pipe results through table _time, ups_name, location, runtime_min, load_pct, battery_status for operator readability.

Step 3 — Validate
Spot-check Splunk samples against an interactive snmpwalk of upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining for the same UPS management IP and timestamp skew; reconcile discrepancies before promoting thresholds.

Step 4 — Operationalize
Publish dashboards highlighting minimum runtime_min per site, route alert actions through email or ticketing, and capture Splunk audit trails showing who acknowledged each incident tied to snmp:ups feeds.
